title: 第一卷 第26章 她比想象中，玩得开
content_zh:
霍放没有立刻回答她。

    他抬眸的那一刹那，就对上了傅承言深邃又锐利的眼神。

    “我不想让你受伤害。”霍放没有说，不是因为不爱她。

    赵亦可把眼泪都蹭在他的肩膀上，跟小时候一样。

    小时候她哭了，她也是把眼泪鼻涕都蹭在霍放的肩膀上。

    那个时候，霍放一边嫌弃，一边安慰她。

    “你答应过我爸妈，会照顾我一辈子的。”赵亦可必须得让他记得这句承诺。

    霍放点头，“嗯。”

    赵亦可这才笑了。

    她抬头，看到他肩膀上的泪渍，轻轻拍了拍，“你要不要去换件衣服，我给你弄脏了。”

    霍放偏头看了眼，“没事。”

    他这个反应，才让赵亦可心里舒坦了些。

    “那你们坐着，我去给你们做好吃的。”赵亦可情绪来得快，去得也快，“今天我特意冒着雨去超市买了些新鲜菜，就是想着来给你做吃的。”

    赵亦可已经往厨房去了。

    霍放起身，走到外面的阳台。

    他点了支烟，雨小了，这会儿外面有点凉意。

    傅承言跟着出去，把玻璃门拉上。

    “谁在你卧室？”傅承言问他。

    霍放倚着栏杆，看了他一眼。

    傅承言嗤笑，“亦可单纯，也好哄骗。你总不能以为，我也跟她一样好哄骗吧。”

    霍放吸着咽，“以后，少带她来我这里。”

    “是童喻？”

    “……”霍放脑子里浮现出童喻的模样。

    那个女人，美艳，聪明，大胆，还听话。

    和她在一起，他很放松。

    傅承言侧着身，睨着他，“你不会跟她玩出感情了吧？”

    霍放手指轻轻弹着烟灰，又吸了一口，吐出来的气瞬间沉默在空气里，“你会找一个在夜场跳舞的女人当老婆吗？”

    傅承言挑眉。

    答案不言而喻。

    他们这种家庭出身的人，找对象是有讲究的。

    不是什么女人，都有资格成为他们的妻子。

    “你就不怕，她纠缠你？”

    “她不会。”霍放非常有自信，“她比想象中的，玩得开。”

    傅承言轻笑，“真是难得，你这网传的花名，总算是应验了。”

    “只是没遇到合拍的。”
content_en:
Huo Fang didn't answer her immediately.

    The moment he raised his eyes, he met Fu Chengyan's deep and sharp eyes.

    "I don't want you to get hurt." Huo Fang didn't say it, not because he didn't love her.

    Zhao Yike wiped his tears on his shoulders, just like when he was a child.

    When she cried when she was a child, she would rub her tears and snot on Huo Fang's shoulder.

    At that time, Huo Fang was disgusted and comforted her at the same time.

    "You promised my parents that you would take care of me for the rest of my life." Zhao Yike had to make him remember this promise.

    Huo Fang nodded, "Yeah."

    Only then did Zhao Yike laugh.

    She looked up and saw the tear stains on his shoulders, and patted them gently, "Do you want to change clothes? I'll stain them for you."

    Huo Fang turned his head and glanced, "It's okay."

    His reaction made Zhao Yike feel more comfortable.

    "Then you sit down and I'll make something delicious for you." Zhao Yike's emotions came and went as quickly as they came, "I went to the supermarket in the rain to buy some fresh vegetables today just to make something for you."

    Zhao Yike has already gone to the kitchen.

    Huo Fang got up and walked to the balcony outside.

    He lit a cigarette. The rain had subsided and it was a bit cool outside now.

    Fu Chengyan followed him out and closed the glass door.

    "Who is in your bedroom?" Fu Chengyan asked him.

    Huo Fang leaned on the railing and glanced at him.

    Fu Chengyan sneered, "I can be naive or easy to coax. You can't think that I am as easy to coax as she is."

    Huo Fang swallowed, "In the future, don't bring her to my place."

    "Is it Tong Yu?"

    "..." Tong Yu's appearance appeared in Huo Fang's mind.

    That woman is beautiful, smart, bold, and obedient.

    He was relaxed with her.

    Fu Chengyan turned sideways and looked at him, "You won't have feelings for her anymore, will you?"

    Huo Fang flicked the cigarette ashes with his fingers, took another puff, and the breath he exhaled was instantly silenced in the air, "Will you find a woman who dances in a nightclub to be your wife?"

    Fu Chengyan raised his eyebrows.

    The answer is self-evident.

    People from families like them are very particular about finding a partner.

    No woman is qualified to be their wife.

    "Aren't you afraid that she will pester you?"

    "She doesn't know how." Huo Fang was very confident, "She has more fun than expected."

    Fu Chengyan chuckled, "It's really rare that your nickname spread online has finally come true."

    "I just haven't met anyone I'm compatible with."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 26 She has more fun than expected
